proves.claim: With route.reservations on, route <id> --to <seat> reserves the item for that seat through reserveItem.

cli.io-commands-route.to-reserves.why: Without it the reserveItem move has no command, so a reservation cannot be recorded from the CLI.

proves.claim: With route.reservations on, route <id> --off clears the reservation through clearReservation.

cli.io-commands-route.off-clears.why: Without it a reservation could never be lifted from the CLI.

proves.claim: With route.reservations off, route --to and --off are refused with a next step naming the setting and --suggest is unchanged.

cli.io-commands-route.off-by-default-ref.why: Without it an unlisted setting could silently turn on a board-writing command.
